description: Dar Al Wasm Museum presents historical objects connected to the city's past. Visitors move through its indoor exhibits and study the items on display.
Bayt Al Rawi Museum is a history museum with collections of historical artefacts. Visitors explore its rooms to learn how daily life in Riyadh developed over time.
Khazna Al Zaman Museum holds historical objects from different periods of the region's past. Visitors browse the displays and follow the story of the area's development.
Mataf Al Ajdad Museum exhibits items that belonged to earlier generations of Riyadh residents. Visitors view the collections and learn about the traditions behind them.
Dar Al Sijill Museum is an indoor museum of historical records and everyday artefacts. Visitors examine the exhibits and discover how the neighbourhood took shape.
Bayt Al Qawafil Museum focuses on the history of trade routes and travelling caravans. Visitors look at objects once used on journeys across the Arabian Peninsula.
Matherat Najd Museum displays historical items from the Najd region. Visitors tour the galleries and learn about local customs and crafts of the past.
Dar Al Hikaya Museum tells the story of Riyadh through preserved historical objects. Visitors walk through themed displays that trace changes in the city over the years.
Rawaq Al Tarikh Museum is a history museum with exhibits from several periods. Visitors view artefacts and read about the events and communities connected to them.
Khizanat Al Rimal Museum presents objects linked to life in the desert and nearby settlements. Visitors explore its collections of tools, textiles and household items.
Bayt Al Dhakira Museum preserves objects that record local memory and history. Visitors study the displays to understand how residents lived, worked and gathered.
Majlis Al Athar Museum is an indoor museum of archaeological and historical finds. Visitors look at the collection and learn about the area's early history.
Ruwaq Al Alwan Gallery is an indoor gallery showing paintings by artists working in Saudi Arabia. Visitors walk past the framed works and observe the use of colour and form.
Dar Al Farsha Gallery exhibits paintings and works on canvas in a series of display rooms. Visitors view the pieces and compare the styles of different artists.
Mashrabiya Art House is an art gallery inspired by traditional wooden lattice design. Visitors see artworks that draw on regional patterns and architecture.
Sada Al Khat Gallery focuses on calligraphy and written-word art. Visitors study the lettering styles in each piece and observe how artists use script.
Lawha Najdiyya Gallery presents paintings that depict scenes and traditions of the Najd region. Visitors browse the artworks and see how local themes appear in art.
Bayt Al Ibda Gallery is an art venue that displays works by emerging and established painters. Visitors circulate through the exhibition spaces and view changing selections of artwork.
Atelier Al Ishraq is a gallery and studio space for painting and mixed media. Visitors see finished works and observe the techniques artists use.
Manzil Al Rassam Gallery shows portraits, landscapes and abstract paintings. Visitors move between the exhibits and look closely at brushwork and composition.
Khayal Art Space is a gallery dedicated to imaginative and experimental artwork. Visitors view installations and paintings that explore a range of ideas.
Dar Al Lawn Gallery is an indoor gallery devoted to colour-focused painting. Visitors examine works in varied palettes and read about the artists behind them.
Sahat Al Fann Gallery hosts exhibitions of paintings and other visual art. Visitors tour the displays and see how artists approach different subjects.
Ruya Contemporary Gallery presents modern and contemporary art from artists in the region. Visitors view current exhibitions and consider the themes in each work.
Qasr Al Sabr Fortress is a historic fort built for defence and local administration. Visitors explore its walls and courtyards on foot.
Hayy Al Tin Old Quarter is a historic district of mud-brick buildings and narrow lanes. Visitors stroll through the quarter and observe its traditional architecture.
Burj Al Hajar Fort is a historic stone fort with defensive towers. Visitors walk around the structure and view its construction up close.
Zuqaq Al Nakhla Old Quarter is an old residential area with traditional houses and alleys. Visitors wander through the district and see how the buildings are arranged.
Qasr Al Samar Palace is a historic palace once used for gatherings and receptions. Visitors tour its halls and courtyards and learn about its former role.
Hara Al Ramth Old Quarter is a heritage area of old dwellings and small squares. Visitors explore the neighbourhood on foot and observe its traditional building styles.
Qalat Al Wadi Fort is a historic fortification overlooking a nearby valley. Visitors walk along its ramparts and view the surrounding landscape.
Sur Al Madina Wall Quarter preserves sections of an old city wall and the streets beside it. Visitors follow the wall's course and see how the quarter was once enclosed.
Qasr Al Mazraa Palace is a historic palace set beside former farmland. Visitors explore its rooms and grounds and learn how the estate was used.
Hisn Al Turab Fort is a historic fort with watchtowers and thick earthen walls. Visitors explore the building and see how it guarded the settlement.
Darb Al Tujjar Old Quarter is a historic district once associated with merchants and trade. Visitors walk its old streets and look at the surviving shopfronts and houses.
Qasr Al Shuyukh Palace is a historic palace linked to local leaders. Visitors tour its reception rooms and courtyards on foot.
Footsteps of the Elders Walking Tour is a guided heritage tour of a historic area. A guide leads visitors through the old quarter and explains the history of its buildings.
Palace Lanes Heritage Tour is a guided walk through the old lanes around a historic palace district. A guide explains the history of the buildings and the people who lived there.
Old Trade Route Tour follows a historic merchant route through the old city with a guide. Visitors walk the old streets while the guide explains how goods and travellers once moved through the area.
Stories of the Mudbrick Wall Tour is a guided heritage walk along a historic earthen wall. The guide explains how the wall was built and how it shaped the settlement.
Najdi Doors and Courtyards Tour is a guided walk focused on traditional Najdi architecture. A guide explains the carved doors and open courtyards found in the old buildings.

Whispers of the Old Quarter Tour is a guided heritage walk through the historic streets of the old city. The guide shares accounts of daily life in the old neighbourhood as the group moves between sites.
Valley Heritage Trail Tour is a guided walk along a historic wadi. A guide explains how the valley supported farms and settlements in earlier times.
Caravan Memories Walking Tour is a guided heritage walk about the history of overland trade. Visitors follow a guide past old buildings linked to travelling merchants.
Lamps of the Old City Tour is a guided walk through a historic quarter. The guide explains how lighting and evening life shaped the old city's routines.
Founders Path Heritage Tour is a guided walk through sites connected to the early history of the settlement. A guide explains the history of the sites along the route.
Keepers of the Old Gate Tour is a guided heritage walk centred on a historic city gate. The guide explains its defensive purpose and the streets that once surrounded it.
Sandstone Quarter Evening Tour is a guided heritage walk. A guide explains the sandstone buildings and the history of the quarter as the group walks.
Palm Court Gardens is a city garden planted with rows of date palms. Visitors stroll the grounds and spend time among the trees and lawns.
Wadi Breeze Park is a public park inspired by the nearby wadi landscape. Visitors walk through planted areas and spend time outdoors among native vegetation.
Olive Walk Garden is a city garden lined with olive trees and flowering shrubs. Visitors walk through the planted grounds and enjoy the greenery.
Jasmine Terrace Park is a public park known for its jasmine plantings and shaded corners. Visitors wander the grounds and take in the scent of the flowers.
Acacia Meadow Park is an urban park with open grass and acacia trees. Visitors walk across the meadow and spend time outdoors beneath the canopy.
Sidr Tree Gardens is a garden planted with sidr trees native to the region. Visitors explore the grounds and learn about the local plant life.
Fountain Lawn Park is a city park built around a lawn and several fountains. Visitors stroll the grounds and watch the water features.
Date Grove Promenade is a garden of date palms arranged in long rows. Visitors walk beneath the trees and observe the grove.
Rose Circle Garden is a garden with circular beds of roses and other flowering plants. Visitors walk around the beds and view the seasonal blooms.
Palm Ridge Botanical Garden is a botanical garden with named collections of regional and desert plants. Visitors explore the plantings and learn about the species grown there.
Lakeside Pines Park is a city park with a small lake and pine trees along its edge. Visitors walk around the water and spend time in the green space.
Green Crescent Park is a curved public park with lawns, trees and flower beds. Visitors walk through the grounds and enjoy the open space.
Sand Valley Camp is a desert camp set among sand dunes. Visitors spend time in the dunes and take part in traditional camp activities.
Rocky Rim Dune Safari is a desert experience that crosses sand dunes near a rocky escarpment. Visitors travel by vehicle across the dunes and view the desert landscape.
Starlit Sands Camp is a desert camp where visitors spend time in the dunes. Guests gather outdoors to observe the night sky over the sand.
Sunset Ridge Dune Drive is a desert experience by vehicle over ridges of sand. Visitors travel through the dunes and stop to watch the sun set.
Falcon Wing Desert Camp is a desert camp with a focus on falconry traditions. Visitors watch falcon displays and learn about the birds in a dune setting.
Golden Hour Sand Trek is a guided desert walk across dunes. Visitors trek over the sand and view the changing light on the landscape.
Bedouin Fire Camp is a desert camp inspired by traditional Bedouin hospitality. Visitors gather around an open fire and take part in customary camp activities.
Silent Dunes Overnight Camp is a desert camp where visitors stay a night among the dunes. Guests experience the open desert and the sky after dark.
Camel Trail Dune Camp is a desert camp offering camel rides across the sand. Visitors ride along a dune route and then spend time at the camp.
Oryx Plains Desert Camp is a desert camp on open gravel plains where oryx may be seen. Visitors take part in camp activities and look out over the landscape.
Moonrise Sand Sea Camp is a desert camp set within a wide area of sand dunes. Visitors gather to watch the moon rise over the sand.
Dune Crest Quad Expedition is a desert experience on quad bikes over sand dunes. Visitors ride along dune routes and cross the desert terrain.
Wadi Al Qata Reserve is a nature reserve centred on a seasonal wadi. Visitors observe native plants and look for birds and small animals along the valley.
Hafat Al Sakhr Reserve protects a stretch of rocky cliffs and the land below them. Visitors explore the terrain and observe desert vegetation and wildlife.
Raudat Al Zuhur Reserve is a nature reserve built around a shallow depression that fills with greenery after rain. Visitors look for wildflowers, grasses and visiting birds.
Wadi Al Uqab Nature Reserve is a valley reserve with acacia trees and rocky slopes. Visitors walk through the wadi and observe the plants and wildlife that live there.
Shaib Al Sail Reserve is a nature reserve around a narrow seasonal watercourse. Visitors watch for waterbirds and study the plants that grow where rainwater gathers.
Umm Sidr Nature Reserve is named for its sidr trees and open scrubland. Visitors explore the grounds and observe birds, insects and desert plants.
Wadi Al Ghaf Trails is a nature reserve of hiking routes through a ghaf tree valley. Visitors hike between the trees and observe the wildlife of the wadi.
Jabal Al Sawan Reserve is a nature reserve on a reddish rocky hill and its surrounding slopes. Visitors climb through the terrain and observe hardy plants and animals.
Raudat Al Arfaj Reserve is a grassland reserve where arfaj shrubs cover the ground. Visitors walk across the plain and look for grazing animals and ground-nesting birds.
Wadi Al Dhib Nature Reserve is a reserve in a wide valley of gravel beds and scattered trees. Visitors survey the landscape and record the wildlife they spot.
Shaqq Al Talh Reserve is a nature reserve within a rocky gorge shaded by talh trees. Visitors explore the gorge and observe its plants, reptiles and birds.
Al Hadba Plateau Reserve is a nature reserve on an upland of rock and sparse vegetation. Visitors cross the plateau and observe desert species adapted to the terrain.
Burj Al Ufuq Deck is an observation deck at the top of a tower in the city centre. Visitors look out over the skyline and the surrounding streets.
Al Qimma Tower Deck is a high viewing point above the business quarter. Visitors view the nearby towers and the wider city.
Minarat Al Nujum Deck is an observation deck on a tall tower. Visitors take in views of the neighbourhoods below and the horizon beyond.
Sama Al Riyadh Lookout is a high lookout with open views across the city. Visitors identify landmarks and watch the light change over the rooftops.
Burj Al Rih Observation Deck is a viewing platform at the upper level of a tower. Visitors look across the city grid toward the edge of the desert.
Nafitha Al Ghuyum Deck is an observation deck with wide views over the western side of the city. Visitors look out toward the wadi and the open land beyond.
Qimat Al Mashhad Tower is a tower with a viewing area at its top. Visitors survey the skyline and the roads that run through it.
Al Rafraf Skyview Deck is an observation deck above the surrounding buildings. Visitors take in views of the city and photograph its skyline.
Manar Al Madina Deck is a lookout on a slim tower that rises above the neighbourhood. Visitors look over the city in every direction.
Burj Al Ghurub Deck is an observation deck with views toward the western horizon. Visitors watch the sun set behind the city skyline.
Ufuq Najd Lookout is a high viewpoint facing the plateau of Najd. Visitors look past the towers to the distant landscape.
Sahat Al Sama Deck is an open-air observation deck high above the street. Visitors view the city's towers, avenues and rooftops from above.
Souq Al Nahhasin is a traditional market where coppersmiths sell metal pots and trays. Visitors browse the stalls and watch how the items are made.
Souq Al Khayyatin is an open-air market of tailors and fabric sellers. Visitors look through the stalls and see cloth, thread and garments being prepared.
Souq Al Ghazl is a traditional market that sells spun wool and woven goods. Visitors walk between the stalls and look at the textiles on offer.
Souq Al Mishkhab is an open-air market with stalls selling woven rugs and household textiles. Visitors browse the goods and talk with the traders.
Souq Al Dallalin is a traditional market known for its auction-style trading. Visitors watch traders call out goods and see how deals are made.
Souq Al Samn is a market of stalls selling clarified butter, honey and other regional foods. Visitors sample local produce and browse the displays.
Souq Al Hinna is a traditional market where traders sell henna and related plant products. Visitors walk the lanes and see the powders and pastes on the stalls.
Souq Al Zarabil is an open-air market selling carpets and rugs. Visitors compare the patterns and colours laid out by the stallholders.
Souq Al Bukhoor is a traditional market of incense, resins and perfume oils. Visitors explore the stalls and notice the scents of the different blends.
Souq Al Sagha is a market of jewellers and metalworkers with stalls of silver and gold items. Visitors browse the displays and watch the craftspeople at work.
Souq Al Kutub is an open-air market where traders sell books, manuscripts and stationery. Visitors look through the stalls and browse the titles on offer.
Souq Al Tamr is a traditional market devoted to dates of many varieties. Visitors taste samples and talk with the sellers about each type.
Bawwabat Al Shams Mall is an indoor shopping mall with a range of retail stores. Visitors browse the shops, stop for refreshments and spend time in its central halls.
Marsa Al Najma Mall is an indoor shopping mall with clothing, home and gift stores. Visitors walk through the retail areas and pause at its dining outlets.
Riwaq Al Hadath Mall is a covered shopping centre with fashion and lifestyle stores. Visitors compare products across the shops and meet friends in its dining areas.
Mujamma Al Yaqut Mall is an indoor mall with stores selling everyday goods and accessories. Visitors shop, eat at its food outlets and browse the seasonal displays.
Sahat Al Tijara Mall is a shopping mall organised around a central trading court. Visitors look through the stores and sample dishes from its eateries.
Ufuq Al Medina Mall is an indoor mall serving the business quarter. Visitors shop for clothing and electronics and take meals at its cafes.
Qaryat Al Dhiya Mall is a shopping mall arranged like a small village of stores. Visitors wander between the retail units and stop at its cafes and restaurants.
Mujamma Al Fajr Mall is an indoor shopping centre with a mix of local and international retailers. Visitors browse the stores and gather in its food court.
Mawqif Al Tuyur Mall is a shopping mall themed around birds and flight. Visitors explore its stores, view the decorative installations and visit the dining outlets.
Bawabat Al Rimal Mall is an indoor mall with stores for fashion, perfume and homeware. Visitors shop across its retail areas and take breaks at the cafes.
Mujamma Al Ward Mall is a covered shopping centre decorated with floral motifs. Visitors browse the boutiques and homeware shops and eat at its restaurants.
Sahat Al Qamar Mall is an indoor mall with retail stores and entertainment venues. Visitors shop, watch screenings and dine in its food areas.
Matbakh Al Jidd Restaurant serves traditional Najdi dishes prepared from regional recipes. Diners order grilled meats, rice dishes and stews and share the meal at the table.
Mandi House Al Ghurub is a restaurant specialising in mandi, a slow-cooked rice and meat dish. Diners eat large shared platters and drink traditional tea.
Bayt Al Qahwa Cafe is a cafe focused on Arabic coffee and light snacks. Visitors drink freshly brewed coffee with dates and pastries.
Tannour Al Hara Restaurant is a restaurant that bakes bread and meats in a clay oven. Diners order flatbreads and grilled dishes cooked in the tannour.
Saj and Embers Restaurant prepares flatbreads on a domed griddle and meats over charcoal. Diners choose from wraps, grills and mezze served hot from the kitchen.
Kabsa Courtyard Restaurant serves kabsa, a spiced rice dish with chicken or lamb. Diners eat in an open courtyard setting and share large plates.
Dukkan Al Bunn Cafe is a coffee shop that roasts and serves specialty beans. Visitors order espresso drinks and filter coffee with cakes and cookies.
Maqha Al Wadi Cafe is a cafe serving tea, coffee and desserts in a garden-inspired setting. Visitors enjoy a drink and sample regional sweets.
Hail Table Kitchen is a restaurant serving dishes from the Hail region. Diners try local stews, breads and grilled meats made from regional recipes.
Mirsal Cafe is a cafe offering hot drinks, juices and baked goods. Visitors meet over a cup of coffee and choose from a menu of light meals.
Dalla and Dates Cafe is a cafe that pairs Arabic coffee from traditional dallah pots with a variety of dates. Visitors taste different date types and sample date-based desserts.
Najd Hearth Restaurant is a restaurant cooking regional dishes over open flames. Diners order roasted meats, grains and vegetable plates inspired by central Arabian cooking.
Dar Al Hakawati Theatre is a theatre that stages storytelling and spoken-word plays. Audiences watch performances based on folktales and local narratives.
Layali Al Ardha Show is a live performance of the traditional ardah sword dance, with drums and poetry. Audiences watch the dancers and listen to the rhythmic chanting.
Qamar Al Layl Concert Hall is a venue for concerts. Audiences attend performances by orchestras, singers and instrumental ensembles.
Sahat Al Ghina Amphitheatre is an open-air amphitheatre that hosts musical performances. Audiences gather outdoors to hear live singers and bands.
Masrah Al Raha Theatre is a theatre presenting plays and stage productions. Audiences watch dramas and comedies performed by local casts.
Ard Al Funun Festival Stage is an outdoor stage used for seasonal festivals. Audiences watch a programme of music, dance and cultural performances.
Nujum Al Sahra Winter Show is a seasonal live show staged during the cooler months. Audiences watch musical acts and dance performances in an open-air setting.
Sada Al Oud Concert Hall is a concert venue dedicated to music of the oud and other string instruments. Audiences listen to solo recitals and ensemble performances.
Haflat Al Shita Winter Show is a seasonal show held in winter. Audiences attend performances featuring music, theatre and dance.
Layali Al Ahlam Theatre is a theatre staging dramatic productions and musical plays. Audiences watch new and classic works presented on its main stage.
Zaman Al Tarab Concert Hall is a concert hall presenting classical Arabic music. Audiences listen to singers and orchestras perform traditional musical styles.
Majlis Al Sameer Theatre is a theatre modelled on a traditional evening gathering. Audiences watch poetry, music and short plays performed in a conversational style.
